note: The single source of truth for what this fixture declares. test/fixtures/motion-site.test.ts reads it, so a case removed from the page fails a test instead of silently shrinking the ground truth. Do not maintain a second copy of this list anywhere — link here instead.

declares.expect: An infinite CSS @keyframes animation named 'pulse' on this element, declared in style.css.
An Element.animate() animation started from motion.js, discoverable via document.getAnimations().
A gsap.timeline() with three tweens, reachable from gsap.globalTimeline.getChildren().
A tween nested inside a gsap.timeline() and nothing else. No top-level tween targets this element, so an extractor that does not descend into child timelines reports nothing for it.
A ScrollTrigger-driven tween that only runs on scroll, reachable from ScrollTrigger.getAll().
A hand-written carousel with next/prev controls and autoplay. This is the canonical 'did replay actually work' case.
An IntersectionObserver-gated image below the fold. Its URL appears only in data-lazy-src, so a parse-time fetch cannot happen and the capture sweep has to trigger it.
A <link> to a stylesheet on a second origin with no CORS header, so document.styleSheets[n].cssRules throws. Spike Q3 asks whether CSS.getStyleSheetText reads it anyway.
An empty host present in the served HTML; motion.js inserts real content into it after load.
A <script> for /build/instrumented.js — minified, with a published //# sourceMappingURL. computeHeroParallaxOffset survives only in the map.

identityCases.expect: Several identical siblings with no distinguishing attribute or text — a structural path cannot tell them apart.
An open shadow root containing an animated element, so identity injection has to patch attachShadow.
A same-origin iframe with its own animation, so frame keys have to be derived rather than assumed.
A host that receives a child well after load, so identity has to come from a MutationObserver rather than the initial preorder walk.
An element removed and re-added on a timer. Reconciliation must not silently rebind it to a new id, and must emit identity-unresolved when it cannot decide.
